name: potmoved
note: PRACTICE SUB-GOAL: MOVE THE POT. The pot is on the counter. Your program's whole job is to grab the pot and lift it up at least 5cm so it moves. Write ONE short program (executable code, no fences): import numpy as np at the top. Step 1: navigate_to('counter'). Step 2: obs=get_observation(); rgb=obs['robot0_robotview']['images']['rgb']; dep=obs['robot0_robotview']['images']['depth']; it=obs['robot0_robotview']['intrinsics']; pm=obs['robot0_robotview']['pose_mat']. Step 3: find the pot: loop prompts ['pot','kettle','saucepan','metal pot','pan','water']; r=segment_sam3_text_prompt(rgb,p); if r and r[0]['mask'].sum()>=50: mask=r[0]['mask']; break. If still none: pt=point_prompt_molmo(rgb,'pot'); if pt and 'pot' in pt: u,v=pt['pot'][0]; mask=np.zeros(rgb.shape[:2],bool); mask[max(0,v-50):v+50,max(0,u-50):u+50]=True. Step 4: seg=np.zeros(rgb.shape[:2],int); seg[mask]=1; poses,scores=plan_grasp(dep,it,seg); if len(poses)>0: i=int(np.argmax(scores)); g=pm@poses[i]; pos=g[:3,3]; R=g[:3,:3];  quaternion from R: tr=np.trace(R); if tr>0: w=0.25*np.sqrt(tr+1); x=(R[2,1]-R[1,2]); y=(R[0,2]-R[2,0]); z=(R[1,0]-R[0,1]); else: use the standard case; q=np.array([w,x,y,z]); q=q/np.linalg.norm(q). Step 5: approach=pos+[0,0,0.12]; move_to_joints(solve_ik(approach,q)); move_to_joints(solve_ik(pos,q)); close_gripper(); lift=pos+[0,0,0.22]; move_to_joints(solve_ik(lift,q)). Wrap EVERY navigate/move/close in try/except:pass so it always runs to the end. Do not do anything else (no stove, no burner) -- just move the pot. Keep it under ~60 lines.
